_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_workload_manager: manual: run each workload locally; slurm: schedule tracing jobs through Slurm.
_root_dir: Host directory mounted as /home/<user> in each trace container.
_application_dir: SPEC CPU2026 installation mounted at $tmpdir/application in each trace container.
_scarab_path: Scarab source tree containing the tracing build.
_scarab_build: Scarab build mode: opt, opt-avx, dbg, or null.
_traces_dir: Destination directory for successfully collected traces.
_trace_name: Unique in-progress trace directory name under <root_dir>/simpoint_flow.
_disabled_trace_configurations: JSON은 주석을 지원하지 않아서, 실행 대기 및 완료된 workload는 이 비활성 필드에 보관한다.
